description_en: Calls ListContactFlows to retrieve the list of IVR contact flows in a call center instance
description_zh: 调用ListContactFlows获取呼叫中心实例中的IVR流程列表
name: ListContactFlows

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

AppliedVersion.description_en: The version that is currently in use

ContactFlowDescription.description_en: The description of the contact flow

ContactFlowId.description_en: The unique ID of the contact flow. This is a system-generated unique identifier
ContactFlowId.description_zh: 联系流唯一ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

ContactFlowName.description_en: The name of the contact flow. The name must be unique within an instance
ContactFlowName.description_zh: 联系流名称，在一个实例内名称不能重复

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the call center instance to which the contact flow belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 联系流所归属的呼叫中心实例

PhoneNumber.description_en: The list of phone numbers associated with the contact flow
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 联系流所绑定的电话号码列表

AllowOutbound.description_en:
Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. The result depends on:

Carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls. 
Call center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, the carrier can configure the setting so that callers hear a prompt tone. The number is not associated with a contact flow IVR. However, this practice is not recommended
AllowOutbound.description_zh:
是否允许外呼。结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼 
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音；该号码不绑定联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the call center to which the phone number belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 电话号码所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

PhoneNumberDescription.description_en: The description of the phone number

PhoneNumberId.description_en: The ID of the phone number. This is a system-generated unique identifier
PhoneNumberId.description_zh: 电话号码ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

RemainingTime.description_en: The remaining call time for the test number. Unit: minutes
RemainingTime.description_zh: 测试号码剩余的通话时间。单位为分钟

TestOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the phone number is a test number

Trunks.description_en: The number of trunks for the phone number, which indicates the number of simultaneous calls supported. The data is provided by the carrier
Trunks.description_zh: 电话号码的中继数量。即可同时支持几路通话，数据来源于大于

Usage.description_en:
The usage of the phone number. Valid values:

Inbound: inbound calls only.
Outbound: outbound calls only.
Bidirection: both inbound and outbound calls.

The values above are defined by the PhoneNumberType enumeration.

The result depends on:

Carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
Call center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, the carrier can configure the setting so that callers hear a prompt tone. The number is not connected to agents or contact flow IVR. However, this practice is not recommended
Usage.description_zh:
电话号码的用途。取值：呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outbound），以及同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）。上述值由枚举类型PhoneNumberType定义。

该值的结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音；该号码不连接人和联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

Type.description_en: The type of the contact flow, as defined by ContactFlowType
Type.description_zh: 流程类型, 定义来自于ContactFlowType

ContactFlowVersion.description_en: All versions of the contact flow file. Stored externally
ContactFlowVersion.description_zh: 联系流文件的所有版本。外表存贮

ContactFlowVersionDescription.description_en: The description and notes for the contact flow version
ContactFlowVersionDescription.description_zh: 联系流版本的说明及注解

ContactFlowVersionId.description_en: The ID of the contact flow version. This is a system-generated unique identifier
ContactFlowVersionId.description_zh: 联系流版本ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

LastModified.description_en: The time when the contact flow version was last modified. The value is the number of milliseconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT
LastModified.description_zh: 联系流版本的最后修改时间。the number of milliseconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 GMT

LastModifiedBy.description_en: The user who last modified the contact flow version
LastModifiedBy.description_zh: 联系流版本最后由何人修改

LockedBy.description_en:
The user who locked the contact flow version.

Before editing, you must lock the version. After editing, unlock the version. This prevents conflicts caused by multiple users modifying the same version simultaneously. When the version is locked, only the user who locked it can perform operations on it. Other users cannot perform operations. When no user has locked the version, the value of this property is NULL
LockedBy.description_zh:
联系流版本被何人锁定。

在开始编辑前必须先将此版本锁定，编辑完成后解锁，这样可以避免多人同时修改一个版本而导致的冲突。在锁定的情况下，只有锁定人才能对其进行操作，其他人无权操作。无人锁定时该属性的值为NULL

Version.description_en: The version information of the contact flow, typically represented as a date and time
Version.description_zh: 联系流版本信息，一般以日期+时间来表示

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
